sentences.text:
The current account bearing Account No.63028430751 of M/s Dinesh Kumar and Prafful Kumar &
Company maintained in State Bank of India, Siyaganj Branch Indore has been debit freezed for the reason that proceeds of crime to the tune of Rs.20,50,000/- has been transferred from the firm Dhanlaxmi Traders of accused Raja Verma on 04.06.2020 (Rs.10 lacs) and on 08.06.2020 (Rs.12 lacs).

entities.text: Dinesh Kumar Jain vs Police Station Indore Mhow on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This revision is preferred on the ground that he has no connection with the aforesaid crime.
The trial Court has recorded incorrect fining that he is absconding.
Three years has been elapsed since freezing the account.
The suspected amount of Rs.20,50,000/- may be withhold by FDR or otherwise by means of any condition that deems fit and rest of the amount may be released.
5. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the petition.

6. Considering the order dated 13.03.2025 passed in ST No.56/2021 even if the investigation is pending regarding the amount of Rs.20,50,000/- then also revision petitioner may be permitted to operate the account keeping the disputed amount of Rs.20,50,000/- safe in current account.

Accordingly, the order dated 21.09.2023 is set aside and this criminal revision is allowed to the extent that the debit freeze of the current account bearing Account NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:21825 3 CRR-2-2024 No.63028430751 of petitioner/firm be unfreezed from Crime No.266/2020 registered at Police Station Dr. Ambedkar Nagar, Indore keeping the disputed amount of Rs.20,50,000/- safe in the current account 9.

entities.text: Police Station Dr. Ambedkar Nagar, Indore
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
With the aforesaid direction, this revision petition is allowed & disposed of.
C.C. as per rules.
